label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity and validity-date filtering will remove cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing write admission or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor-retrieval should select the requested entity; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary should return the record valid at the requested date. Retrieval distraction and stale-fact errors should decrease, with no expected storage increase.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values during repeated confirmations, reducing stored records without changing retrieval answers or write admission.
predicted_effect: The duplicate-confirmation scenario should retain the German answer while avoiding redundant version records; complete-scenario success should remain at least as high and storage should decrease. No hard-constraint impact is expected.
